state2.catalog_variant_a.text:
We specialize in crafting authentic, unforgettable traditional celebrations! 🌟

Here are the key events we cater to:
✨ Weddings, Engagements & Receptions
🎃 Upanayanam, Housewarmings & Baby Showers (Seemantham)
🎉 Birthdays, Anniversaries & Family Gatherings
🙏 Traditional Ceremonies & Religious Poojas

Our core expertise spans Pure Vegetarian South Indian Catering (Karnataka, Andhra, Tamil Nadu & Kerala cuisines), Stage & Theme Floral Decor, Pooja Setups, and End-to-End Event Planning.

Which of these special occasions are you planning today, {who}?

state2.catalog_variant_b.text:
We’d love to share! Srivatsanka provides complete end-to-end event solutions tailored to your family's traditions. ✨

Our Core Services Include:
🍱 Pure Vegetarian Regional Catering: Authentic South Indian feasts across Karnataka, Andhra, Tamil Nadu & Kerala recipes.
🌸 Bespoke Decor: Stage, floral, mandap, and theme setups.
🪔 Ritual & Pooja Support: Traditional pooja arrangements, sacred ceremony setups, and ritual coordination.
🏰 Venue & Hospitality: Venue selection, venue planning, and guest management.

Are you looking for full event planning or specific catering/decor services for your upcoming celebration, {who}?
